en.html:
Ichijou was waiting in the clearing among the trees, already armoured.

That steel brought to mind the bottom of the deep sea, the farthest reach of the sky. Perhaps my eyes were deceiving me. Even the raindrops, which ought to have no thoughts whatsoever, seemed frightened of spoiling that colour. Touch it? They appeared unwilling to take such a liberty.

林の中の空地――
　一条は既に装甲を遂げて、俺を待っていた。

　深海の底を、空の果てを想起させる甲鉄。
　錯覚であろうか……心なきはずの雨粒が、その色を
汚す行為に畏怖し、触れてはならじと避けているよう
に見える。

en.html:
Soushuu Gorou Nyuudou Masamune.

Kamui—divine majesty. For this tsurugi, the description was not overselling anything.

An avatar of Yama himself. Even if we were not behind Ennoji, that comparison would have occurred to me.

She stood there to judge evil that could not be forgiven.

Masamune《Khaaaaa... Chhi! What polluted steel is this?》
Masamune《The rumours were accurate. No—the rumours showed restraint! More foul than the sludge rotting at the very bottom of a cesspit!!》
Muramasa《...Such a welcome. I had meant to pay my respects to an illustrious elder. You might at least acknowledge that I came with manners.》
Masamune《Keep them. Accursed Muramasa... through seven hundred idle years I heard your name again and again.》
Masamune《A tsurugi thirsty for blood. An evil armour that maddens human hearts and drives them into pointless war.》
Masamune《And now, this blood-stink soaked into your steel skin... Haan. Every word of it was true.》
Muramasa《...》
Masamune《That age when emperors stood north and south of the home provinces, when all Yamato fought in a whirlpool of chaos... had I found a master then, I would have buried you before your infamy could get properly started!》
Muramasa《...!!》
Masamune《A regret I carry even now. What were the other tsurugi doing? Letting a thing like you run loose—there must be some limit to uselessness, surely—》
Muramasa《Barking band karo, O GREAT MASTERPIECE!!》
Masamune《You...!?》
Muramasa《If you had come out into the world, what would have happened, exactly? Duniya dekhi bhi hai? You straight-laced, box-kept little innocent!》
Muramasa《Nothing. You could have done nothing! Seven hundred years sleeping peacefully in a treasury, watching from outside with no responsibility. Appreciate your luck, you sheltered showpiece...》
Muramasa《Masamune, finest masterpiece under heaven! Of course your steel is beautiful. Not one drop of blood has touched it. Brand-new condition, never used—that is your beauty!》
Masamune《...You have the gall. A mission to fulfil, and more than seven hundred years forced to sleep without accomplishing anything! That anguish—you cannot understand it!》
Muramasa《No, I cannot. Just as you cannot understand what the people who actually lived and fought then suffered!》
Masamune《This clever tongue of yours, I shall put an end to it...! Mido! Come!》
Ichijou"..."

en.html:
The spider's voice jolted me into raising one hand. I looked into the eye sockets of the warrior ahead.

Was the deep-indigo warrior even listening to her tsurugi? No way to tell. She had not moved; her gaze was fixed on me just as mine was on her.

What was she searching for? Had the guilt soaked into these limbs become a thing she needed to weigh again?

　何を窺おうというのか。
　この四肢に染み付いた罪科を、改めて計ろうとでも
するのか。

A list of facts, simply. Objections and personal remarks had no place in it. What was I going to dispute? My name?
